name: Body-Mounted Solar Panels
description: Multi-junction gallium arsenide (GaAs) solar cells bonded directly to the satellite structural panels. Lightweight with zero deployment mechanism risks.

real.source_name: NASA Small Spacecraft Technology State of the Art: Power

name: Deployable UltraFlex Solar Wings
description: Fan-fold ultra-lightweight accordion solar arrays that unfold automatically after orbit insertion. Produces substantial power even at Mars's distance.

real.source_name: NASA ROSA (Roll-Out Solar Array) & UltraFlex flight data

name: High-Capacity Li-Ion Battery Pack
description: Space-qualified lithium-ion cells with integrated thermal heater loops and battery management system (BMS) to supply power during orbital eclipses.

real.source_name: NASA Energy Storage Systems for Small Spacecraft

name: Multi-Mission Radioisotope Generator (MMRTG)
description: Converts heat from the natural radioactive decay of Plutonium-238 into continuous day-and-night electrical power. Completely immune to dust storms and eclipses.
